answer: The registry auctions 40 admission slots each epoch. Applicants post sealed bids; bids open on a lantern board, the top 40 win and pay, and payments burn. Winners get a violet seal bound to one key. Bulk buying bids against itself, so price forms a spiral: first 45, kth 45+8(k-1). 1,000 fakes cost 4,041,000 credits vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-bid ring fails: its violet seal voids on key change. An honest agent bids once, pays 45, keeps its share.
